name: TC SEO / Schema / Sitemap
author: trianglecode

sections.description:
TC SEO / Schema / Sitemap is a lightweight and easy to setup WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that enhances your website’s SEO by adding essential structured data, metadata, sitemap tools, and performance optimizations. Designed to be simple, fast, and effective — no coding required.

If you’ve tried other popular SEO plugins, you know they can be overwhelming to configure. This plugin is designed to be fast, intuitive, and easy to set up, while still covering 99% of your website’s SEO needs. Get all the essential features without the unnecessary complexity, and save time on setup so you can focus on growing your website.

What the plugin offers :

  • Local Business Schema
    Automatically generate a complete Local Business Schema (JSON-LD) and embed it on your site to improve visibility in Google search results, local map packs, and knowledge panels. This helps local customers find and trust your business, boosting both search relevance and conversions with minimal setup.

  • OpenGraph & Web Page Schema
    Add essential OpenGraph tags and Web Page Schema to ensure your pages display correctly on social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and others. This improves link previews, increases click-through rates, and gives search engines clearer data about your content.

  • Website Sitemap
    Generate a clean and optimized webpage sitemap to help search engines crawl and index your website more effectively. This ensures that your most important pages are discoverable and improves your overall SEO health with minimum configuration required.

  • Misc Tools
    Enhance performance by assigning custom Fetch Priority values to selected images / fonts. This allows you to prioritize above-the-fold media for faster rendering, improving page speed and user experience — especially on mobile devices.
    Auto add product title to image alt and title.

  • WPML compatible

PRO version
There is a pro version that adds some extra features :
– Ability to add SEO/OpenGraph title, description and image per post/taxonomy. It supports custom post types / taxonomies too.
– Ability to enter manually the business type in Local Business Schema.

Configuration

The configuration is very straight forward. The plugin consists of the following tabs :

  1. Local Business Schema
    This tab is used to generate valid Schema.org LocalBusiness markup, improving search engine understanding of your business.
  • Enable Local Business Schema
    Enables or disables the Local Business schema output.
  • Business Type
    Select the most appropriate Schema.org business type.
  • Business Name
    The official name of your business.
  • Business Email
    Enter your business contact email
  • Business Description
    Short description of your business
  • Phone Number
    Main contact phone number
  • Business Website URL
  • Logo URL
  • Main Image URL
  • Street Address
  • City
  • Region / State
  • Postal Code
  • Country
  • Latitude
  • Longitude
  • Map URL
  • Opening Hours
  • Price Range
  • Currencies Accepted
  • Payment Methods Accepted
  1. OpenGraph & Web Page Schema
    This tab controls OpenGraph metadata and Schema.org markup for pages, posts, and WooCommerce content.
  • Enable Single Post Schema
    Enables Schema.org markup for single posts.
  • Enable Web Page Schema
    Enables Schema.org WebPage data for standard pages.
  • Enable WOO Archive Schema
    Enables schema markup for WooCommerce archive pages.
  • Enable Product Schema
    Enables Schema.org Product markup for WooCommerce products.
  • Enable OpenGraph / SEO
    Enables OpenGraph and basic SEO metadata output.
  • Fall Back Title
  • Fall Back Description
  • Fall Back Image URL
  • Image Alt
    The opengraph image alt source
  • Use Fallback Data
    Forces fallback values to be used instead of post title, content and featured image.
  • Facebook URL
  • Instagram URL
  • TikTok URL
  • X (Twitter) URL
  • LinkedIn URL
  • Pinterest URL
  • YouTube URL
  1. Sitemap
    This tab controls the XML sitemap functionality of the plugin.
  • Enable Sitemap
    Enables the XML sitemap functionality.
  • Enable sitemap_index.xml
    Enables sitemap_index.xml as an alias to the default wp-sitemap.xml.
  • Post To Include
    Select which post types, custom post types, taxonomies, and custom taxonomies should be included in the sitemap output.
  1. Misc
    This tab contains various optimization and cleanup options.
  • Enable Fetch Priority
    Enables a custom class mechanism to add fetchpriority=”high” to images.
  • Custom Class
    The CSS class name used to search elements where fetchpriority=”high” will be applied to child images.
  • Font Url List
    A list of absolute font URLs that will have fetchpriority=”high” applied.
    One URL per line.
  • Enable Woo Images Alt & Title
    Automatically adds the product title to image alt and title attributes on single product pages.
  • Clear Plugin Data
    Deletes all plugin settings and stored data upon uninstall.
sections.installation:
Download the latest version and extract it into the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
After activation, open the Triangle Code admin menu and enable the features you want.
